topic: YC CEO says he ships 37K LoC AI code per day. A developer looked under the hood
headline: Shipping 37K Lines Daily
caption:
Wow, 37K lines of AI code shipped daily sounds almost unbelievable, but it’s a testament to the power of automation and robust pipelines. As a developer, I know that such numbers often reflect orchestration rather than raw coding. Scalable CI/CD, code generation, and testing tools make this possible without burning out engineers. It’s a reminder that the magic isn’t just coding faster but building systems that enable rapid, reliable deployments. Stay curious, engineers, and remember that behind every high-performance team, there’s a solid foundation of tools and processes. 🚀
